info.title: Cabros Bot API
info.description: Protected alerting and market-analysis APIs. Machine clients use the x-api-key header; the api-key query parameter exists only for legacy compatibility and may leak through logs. The browser admin console can use Firebase ID tokens on documented admin operations when ENABLE_FIREBASE_ADMIN_AUTH=true.

get.summary: Read Binance Spot order status or recent order history
get.description: Reads a single order status by orderId or origClientOrderId, or lists recent orders for an allowed symbol when no specific order identifier is provided.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Binance Spot symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT) from configured allowed symbols list.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Binance order ID to query a specific order status.

parameters.name: origClientOrderId
parameters.description: Original client order ID to query a specific order status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recent orders to return when querying order history (default 50, max 100).

404.description: The requested Binance order was not found.

post.summary: Validate or submit a Binance Spot order
post.description: Live requests require an idempotency key or clientOrderId. Decimal quantities, prices, and quote amounts may be strings to preserve precision. MARKET orders must omit timeInForce. Binance PERCENT_PRICE, PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE, and account-dependent filters such as MAX_POSITION or MAX_NUM_ORDERS use Binance order-test validation before acceptance. Definitive pre-execution or exchange rejections return 400 BINANCE_ORDER_REJECTED; a reconciled order mismatch returns 409 BINANCE_ORDER_CONFLICT; transient order-test failures return retryable 502 BINANCE_VALIDATION_FAILED. Binance execution-unknown code -1006 remains BINANCE_ORDER_STATUS_UNKNOWN.

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with the request, or the recovered Binance order does not match the requested order.

value.error: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload
Reconciled Binance order does not match the request

ApiKeyQuery.name: api-key
ApiKeyQuery.description: Legacy compatibility only. Prefer x-api-key because query strings may be logged.

FirebaseBearerAuth.description: Firebase ID token for the browser admin console. Requires an admin.viewer or admin.operator custom claim; webhook operations remain API-key-only.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-generated key. Matching concurrent or sequential requests replay the original response and jobId; reuse with a different request fingerprint returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The response includes Idempotency-Replay: false for the first request and true for a replay. The x-idempotency-key header is also supported.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Optional replay key. Canonical header form (x-idempotency-key is also supported).

IdempotencyKeyQueryCamel.name: idempotencyKey
IdempotencyKeyQueryCamel.description: Optional legacy-compatible replay key query parameter.

IdempotencyKeyQuerySnake.name: idempotency_key
IdempotencyKeyQuerySnake.description: Optional legacy-compatible replay key query parameter.

DryRun.name: dryRun
DryRun.description: When true, analyze and return alerts without notification delivery, deduplication cache claims/writes, or signal-outcome persistence.

OutcomeLimit.name: limit
OutcomeLimit.description: Maximum number of outcomes to return (1-100).

BeforeCursor.name: before

XIdempotencyKeyHeader.name: x-idempotency-key
XIdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Optional replay key. Alternative x-prefixed header variant.

XRequestIdHeader.name: x-request-id
XRequestIdHeader.description: Optional client-supplied request correlation ID. If provided, it must be 1-128 printable ASCII characters. If omitted or invalid, a UUIDv4 correlation ID is generated automatically. Echoed in the response and persisted on stored alerts.

BinanceOrdersQueryResult.description: Binance Spot order status or recent order history query result.

BinanceOrderResult.description: Validated dry-run or confirmed Binance Spot order. A replay includes idempotencyReplayed=true.

Idempotency-Replay.description: false for the first request, true for a cached replay.

BinanceOrderFailure.description: Binance rejected or could not confirm the order. Definitive exchange rejections return BINANCE_ORDER_REJECTED; transient order-test failures return BINANCE_VALIDATION_FAILED. A live request with an idempotency key derives a deterministic clientOrderId for reconciliation after cache expiration or process restart. A 503 BINANCE_ORDER_STATUS_UNKNOWN response is replayed for the same idempotency key; do not resubmit with a new key until the order status is reconciled.

example.error: Binance accepted or may have accepted the order, but its final status is unknown; do not resubmit with a new idempotency key

JobQueueUnavailable.description: Render-worker mode is enabled but durable Firestore or Redis queue storage is unavailable. JOB_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE means the job was not accepted; JOB_QUEUE_ACCEPTANCE_UNKNOWN means the response includes the durable jobId and must be replayed or polled while the worker reconciles the queue.

StatusResult.description: Non-sensitive runtime readiness. When Firebase Remote Config is enabled, dependencies.firebaseRemoteConfig reports loader metadata only; it never exposes remote parameter values or credentials.

jobId.description: Durably stored job identifier returned when queue acceptance is indeterminate.

populationNote.example: Metrics represent 40 evaluated signals out of 50 total received signals (80% coverage).

byFeatureFlag.description: Includes tradingViewData for requested MCP enrichment, tradingViewDataApplied for successfully applied MCP results, and withoutTradingViewData for requests that did not opt in.

shadowModeMetrics.description: When an object, includes exchangeBreakdown and providerBreakdown coverage buckets with received, eligible, evaluated, pending, and unavailable counts. Equity providers remain opt-in and fail open. This field is omitted when source or enriched filters are supplied because shadow-mode metrics do not support those filters.

discordWebhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS Discord webhook URL override.

idempotency_key.description: Optional replay key; snake_case body form.

ranked.description: When true, sorts each scan by actionable score and includes score/reason entries in scanResults.

includeMultiTimeframe.description: When true, enriches candidates with fail-open higher-timeframe alignment from TradingView MCP. Aligned candidates receive a default +10 score modifier and counter-trend candidates a default -10 modifier. The include_multi_timeframe alias is also accepted.

SymbolAnalysisRequest.description: timeframe defaults to TRADINGVIEW_MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEFRAME at runtime, or 1D when that setting is absent.

enabled.description: Whether any configured Firestore persistence gate is active.

configured.description: Whether the Firestore client is available for scanner presets.

mode.description: durable means Firestore-backed; ephemeral means in-memory fallback and may be lost on restart.

CallbackFields.description: When callbackUrl is configured, each callback POST includes x-callback-timestamp (ISO-8601), x-callback-event, and a UUID x-callback-delivery-id. If a callback secret is configured (via callbackSecret or JOB_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET), x-callback-signature is sent containing an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the newline-delimited timestamp, event, delivery ID, and raw JSON body. The secret itself is never transmitted. Hostname callback delivery is pinned to the public DNS answers that passed private-address validation for that attempt, preventing a second lookup from selecting a private destination; ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS=true is an explicit override. Receivers should reject stale timestamps and deduplicate delivery IDs; retries use new IDs and signatures.

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive a POST with the job result when it reaches a terminal state (or a configured intermediate event). HTTP is allowed only for localhost in development. Hostname callback connections are pinned to the validated public DNS answers for each attempt; any private DNS answer is rejected unless ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS=true.

callbackSecret.description: Optional shared secret used to generate the x-callback-signature HMAC-SHA256 header. The secret is used server-side to compute the signature and is never transmitted in callback requests.

callbackEvents.description: Events that trigger a callback delivery. Defaults to all terminal events: completed, failed, cancelled, timed_out.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the job in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes). Hard cap at 600000 (10 minutes).

dryRun.description: When true, analyze without notification delivery or persistence. The query parameter form is supported for GET and POST.
Present and true when analysis generated alerts without dispatching or persisting them.

quota_exhausted.description: Number of symbols that exhausted Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED retries.

requestedChannels.description: Channels selected for delivery; in dry-run mode these are intended channels.

deliveredChannels.description: Channels that actually received alerts; empty in dry-run mode.

requestId.description: Request correlation ID echoed from the inbound x-request-id header or generated as a UUIDv4.

tradingViewEnrichmentApplied.description: True only when TradingView MCP data was successfully applied to this enrichment.

tradingViewEnrichmentStatus.description: Sanitized TradingView MCP outcome for this alert.

levelsSource.description: Provenance of technical_levels. Set to 'gemini-grounding' only when Gemini-parsed fallback levels are emitted because TradingView MCP data was absent or failed; omitted when MCP-derived levels win (GH-509 / CB-226).

current_price.description: Current price supplied by TradingView MCP enrichment; null when unavailable.

price_data.description: Optional structured TradingView MCP price snapshot (e.g. current_price, high, low).

idempotencyReplayed.description: Present and true when the response was replayed from a matching idempotency key.

status.description: Current job status. Terminal statuses are: completed, failed, cancelled, timed_out.

callbackStatus.description: Callback delivery state, present only when a callbackUrl was configured.

results.description: Per-symbol analysis results (expanded-analysis jobs only, when completed).

scanResults.description: Per-scan results (market-scanner jobs only, when completed). Ranked jobs include scores with symbol, score, reason, and optional trendConfluence entries.

alertText.description: Formatted alert text delivered to notification channels (completed jobs only).

error.description: Error message (failed or timed_out jobs only).

code.description: Machine-readable error code (failed or timed_out jobs only).

symbol.description: Allow-listed Binance Spot symbol, for example BTCUSDT.

quantity.description: Base-asset quantity. Required for LIMIT. Optional for MARKET (evaluated using average price against the notional cap; MARKET BUYs are converted to an exchange-enforced quoteOrderQty at the estimated average price). Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

quoteOrderQty.description: Quote-asset amount for MARKET orders. Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

price.description: Required for LIMIT orders. Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

timeInForce.description: LIMIT-only. MARKET orders must omit this field.

clientOrderId.description: Stable Binance order identity. Required for live requests unless an idempotency key is supplied.

dryRun.description: Validate filters and notional without submitting. Set false only for an enabled operator workflow.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional body form of the idempotency key. Header form is preferred and required for live requests without clientOrderId.

idempotency_key.description: Optional snake_case body form of the idempotency key.

Status.description: Runtime status. TradingView dependencies expose configured endpoint metadata plus runtime status (unknown before an MCP operation, ready after success, degraded after failure), timestamps, sanitized error categories, and success/failure counters without provider response bodies. dependencies.geminiQuota reports Gemini quota cooldown state, remaining cooldown duration, trigger counters, Brave search fallback events during cooldown, and grounding request telemetry counters without exposing prompt text or provider credentials. featureFlags.firestoreJobStorage reports the ENABLE_FIRESTORE_JOB_STORAGE gate or the legacy ENABLE_FIRESTORE_ALERT_STORAGE gate; featureFlags.jobExecutionWorker reports JOB_EXECUTION_MODE=render-worker or firestore-poller; dependencies.jobExecutionQueue reports queue readiness and safe operational counters without broker credentials; featureFlags.firestoreScannerPresets reports ENABLE_FIRESTORE_SCANNER_PRESETS; dependencies.scannerPresetStorage reports the effective durable or ephemeral scanner-preset backend and readiness; dependencies.signalOutcomeWorker reports the scheduler role (web, worker, or disabled), graceful-shutdown state, cadence, heartbeat, and scanned/pending/evaluated/error counters; a disabled local scheduler reports ready false and status disabled because it is not the process evaluating outcomes; dependencies.firestoreJobStorage reports Firestore credential readiness for that runtime path; featureFlags.newsMonitorTestMode reports ENABLE_NEWS_MONITOR_TEST_MODE without changing news monitor behavior; featureFlags.messageFooterMetadata reports ENABLE_MESSAGE_FOOTER_METADATA and defaults to true unless explicitly set to false; featureFlags.cloudflareAig reports ENABLE_CLOUDFLARE_AIG and dependencies.cloudflareAig reports Cloudflare AI Gateway credential readiness; featureFlags.equityMarketData reports ENABLE_EQUITY_MARKET_DATA and dependencies.equityMarketData reports non-sensitive Twelve Data readiness for BATS/NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX/NYSE ARCA outcome evaluation; featureFlags.firebaseRemoteConfig reports ENABLE_FIREBASE_REMOTE_CONFIG and dependencies.firebaseRemoteConfig reports only bounded loader metadata, source, template version, last successful load, and last error category without remote values or credentials; featureFlags.notificationRedrive reports ENABLE_NOTIFICATION_REDRIVE and dependencies.notificationRedrive reports dead-letter redrive worker role, configuration, running state, and safe operational counters.
